description.purpose: Scope marker of the context-compaction lane (GH #120): the three cells that fold the old rounds of one tool loop into a single summary row. Condensation, not eviction -- the store keeps every folded row, only the WINDOW gets smaller.
description.use_when: Behind the re-entry edge of a store-backed tool loop, on the branch that fires once the accumulated prompt-token count crosses the threshold.
description.not_in_scope: No threshold (that is an edge condition), no rebuild (that is the collector), and no deletion of anything, ever. The `refire` route is the lane's own way out when a fold cannot be produced.
